A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-berustew-PC-Errata-2018-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Beru Stew (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same game text. The title is “•Beru Stew”. This is a full card image, 350 × 490 pixels, with a white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The previous slip and the same area of this image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
